method.kpoint_convention: GPAW default Monkhorst-Pack integer mesh; no explicit gamma override or extra offset; slab kz=1
method.wall_clock_check: At each completed SCF iteration; request orderly checkpoint-and-stop at 12600 seconds, leaving a 1800-second margin. launch_r2.sh sends TERM at 14399 seconds and enforces the 14400-second hard deadline; the latest verified checkpoint and logs remain available if the deadline guard must terminate a stuck iteration.

checkpoint_policy.naming: checkpoint/checkpoint_iter_NNNNNN.gpw with an adjacent JSON sidecar binding the GPW SHA-256 to the completed SCF iteration
checkpoint_policy.write_failure: Abort all MPI ranks at the collective boundary; retain previous verified checkpoints and logs; no retry.
checkpoint_policy.readback: Read each newly written GPW with GPAW read_gpw using a serial communicator; verify atoms, cell, PBC, wavefunction presence, file size, SHA-256 and iteration sidecar before marking valid.
checkpoint_policy.iteration_state_note: GPAW GPW stores the current density and wavefunctions; its SCF iteration number is bound by the sidecar to the GPW SHA-256. The GPW is diagnostic and is not an automatic restart instruction.

checkpoint_space_budget.budget_basis: R2 8x8x1 archived wavefunction and projector aggregate byte counts; 2x per-file margin; five interval checkpoints plus one in-progress checkpoint, 1 GiB logs and 5 GiB free-space reserve. Runtime stops if remaining free space falls below one estimated checkpoint plus reserve.

prohibited: k-point, cutoff, smearing, mixer, convergence or PAW changes
